text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The party at Satono's house was 
incredible~~! The venue was so stylish, 
and all the guests were super top-tier!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eveeeerything I saw was so sparkly! I just 
couldn't stop being excited~~♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad to see you enjoyed it♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But, but, personally, the one I 
thought was the best was—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Satono was greeting all the guests, right? 
Seeing her like that gave me an idea~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Her calm composure was so mature! She felt 
so graceful, like a total celebrity!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, it was sooo sparkly! I was 
totally mesmerized♡"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly... my idol...! To think someone as 
stylish as Miss Vivlos would say that to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please be sure to 
visit again. Dia will do her absolute best 
to welcome you!
